prompts.happy: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE square finished standalone anime website background, 1536x1536 preferred, opaque. Image 1 is the approved visual style and recurring room reference. Create a distinct mood variation in the SAME elegant European rose-and-lace tea salon, preserving refined anime painterly illustration, ivory wall panels, warm walnut furniture, muted antique brass, vermilion roses, ivory lace and restrained brick-red velvet curtains. Cohesive palette: ivory #f2eee8, parchment #e9dfd0, warm ink brown #26211e/#352d28, restrained coral/vermilion #ff796c; avoid generic purple/blue fantasy and excessive sugary pink. Mandatory layout: text-safe quiet wall x8%-58%, y15%-45%; no strong patterns, objects or sharp shadows there. Separate character will cover right side x46%-100%, y12%-100%; keep right half subdued; face-safe x65%-90%, y15%-40%. Richest storytelling objects should sit on the left-lower table x5%-42%, y55%-88%, with some small edge framing. Keep 5% crop safety and bottom 10% nonessential. No people, human silhouettes, written text, letters, logos, watermarks, UI or visible coordinate guides. This is a background-only illustration, not a poster or collage. Match reference craft and room identity, but visibly change mood, lighting and props rather than merely recolor it. MOOD: HAPPY, satisfied joy and a small success, companion for an eyes-closed smiling character. Bright clear late-morning sunshine with a sunny honey-ivory glow, slightly open lace curtain, fresh full vermilion roses and an inviting strawberry cream cake with small golden decorative stars on the left tea table, elegant china, a few red petals near the table. Warm cheerful highlights and lively welcoming air without glare. Left upper text zone stays uniformly light ivory for dark lettering; right face zone stays softly illuminated warm neutral. Distinct from reference by brighter airy sunlight and a charming celebratory cake tableau. No balloons, no coins, no financial charts, no party text.
